mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enabledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pausedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errorCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS disabledCount, SUM(CASE WHEN execution_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS runningCount, SUM(CASE WHEN is_builtin = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS builtinCount FROM scheduled_task WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT DISTINCT task_group FROM scheduled_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND task_group IS NOT NULL AND task_group != '' ORDER BY task_group ASC
SELECT * FROM scheduled_task WHERE task_code = #{taskCode} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM scheduled_task WHERE is_builtin = 1 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY task_id ASC
